D001.key_difference: Onset of inattention/hyperactivity-impulsivity and relationship with manic symptoms

D001: Mood changes may occur but are distinct from a manic episode; symptoms of inattention/hyperactivity-impulsivity appear continuously regardless of this.
D008: Symptoms of inattention/hyperactivity-impulsivity occur exclusively during the course of a manic episode.

D001.key_difference: Onset of inattention/hyperactivity-impulsivity and relationship with psychotic symptoms

D001: Psychotic symptoms may co-occur, but inattention/hyperactivity-impulsivity appear continuously from before, unrelated to psychotic symptoms.
D005: Inattention/hyperactivity-impulsivity are observed starting from the prodromal phase or after the onset of psychotic symptoms.

D001: Inattention is caused by external stimuli and interest/curiosity in new activities. Restlessness is unrelated to worry or rumination.
D011: Inattention occurs due to worry or rumination associated with anxiety symptoms.

D001.key_difference: Onset of concentration problems and relationship with depressive symptoms

D001: Mood symptoms may appear but are distinct from a depressive episode; concentration problems appear continuously unrelated to depressive symptoms.
D013: Concentration problems occur exclusively during the major depressive episode.
